title: senecio yegua
intro: Senecio yegua, commonly known as "yerba de la reina," is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio yegua include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its use as an antispasmodic and diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Senecio yegua include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
